newsitem.title: ITALY: German couple die after avalanche in Italy.
newsitem.headline: German couple die after avalanche in Italy.

text.p: A German couple died on Sunday after being caught in an avalanche in the Dolomites mountains near the Italian-Austrian border, police said.
Hernst Brussis, 59, died in hospital but his wife Jutta, 53, died before she could be brought down the slope.
The couple had been skiing in fresh snow when the avalanche occurred. Another tourist skiing nearby raised the alarm.

Officials, who have urged extreme caution in all mountain areas since the recent cold snap, had feared five were missing after two avalanches but later said the German couple were the only victims. One man died in an avalanche last week.
Across Italy, weather conditions improved but more snow and cold was forecast and the northeast coast was bracing for a fierce "bora", the chill wind that sweeps the Adriatic coast.
